# lissajoverse

> The observable universe as a lissajous graph: a retro oscilloscope reborn
> with the constellation's surfaces — the vault's papers, a robots-respecting
> wiki crawl, a NOT-NAND grammar, and The Known Universe.

Source: https://github.com/8b-is/lissajoverse
Live: https://oscilloscope.vaked.dev/

## What it is

- A single-file retro oscilloscope (microphone / output / sine / sawtooth /
  noise) with a lissajous weave: ratio selector (1:1 · 2:3 · 3:4 · 5:8 · 8:13),
  up to seven traces, seeded phase drift
- A universe mode: the atlas (vault papers · fleet · logic seeds · cosmos
  seeds) drawn as a graph on a seeded starfield, edges as lissajous chords,
  degree + closeness centralities mirroring 8b-is-engine's UltraGraph
- A NAND mode: the graph re-woven through the ternary NOT-NAND grammar
- The Known Universe (AMNH) × Time (We Plants Are Happy Plants remix) as a
  video layer
- A robots.txt-respecting wikipedia crawl rig (tools/wikicrawl.py) feeding
  data/atlas.jsonl

## Key data

- data/seeds.json — static seeds: the diatribe shelf, the vault, the fleet,
  logic + cosmos (incl. Hayden Planetarium, Digital Universe Atlas, Uniview,
  Simon Kuznets, leekHotline)
- data/atlas.jsonl — the committed atlas
- tools/wikicrawl.py — the polite crawl (article-HTML channel only)
- selftest.mjs + e2e.sh — the corridor

## Doctrinal notes

Readability is freedom: every mechanism in the page is inspectable, every
behavior is test-pinned, every wall (crawl starvation, HF secret, domain
ownership) is recorded in PLAN.md instead of hidden.
